documentation_improvement.exact_delta: For an owned-process census, classify each retained (PID, creation-time) identity by opening a fresh process handle and comparing creation time before status. Map NoSuchProcess to absent, a changed creation time to reused, zombie status to zombie, and denied or other inspection errors to unknown. Do not signal when the snapshot is incomplete or any identity is reused/unknown. This census rule does not prove hard-deadline enforcement, reader shutdown, descendant reaping, or application-lease closure; record those predicates separately.
